mentions.name: Infralyst
mentions.description: Self-serve AWS cost savings tool for Terraform users. Connects AWS (via a read-only role Terraform module), GitHub, and Terraform state, then finds underused resources and opens pull requests to downsize them, gated by best-practice checks to avoid sketchy changes. Offers a free tier with 3 downsizing PRs per workspace and a $99/mo Pro plan with unlimited PRs.
mentions.problem: AWS teams spend on underused resources and lack an easy, safe way to downsize them.
mentions.audience: Self-serve offering aimed at teams running AWS with Terraform.
